_purpose: Machine-checkable transcription of the 'Same commit as' bindings and the one landing-order constraint declared in SPEC/INDEX.md ('Units that must land in the SAME commit', ~line 293) and the individual SPEC/units/<ID>.md build cards. SPEC/ is Super-Spec planning documentation that lives OUTSIDE this git repository (a sibling directory of repos/openclaw-onboarding under the project root) -- CI cannot read it directly, so this file is the enforceable, repo-local translation. It is maintained by hand: whenever SPEC/INDEX.md's same-commit table gains a row, add the matching group here with "enforce": true (status "pending") while the units are still unbuilt; flip "enforce" to false and "status" to "landed" once a merge-writer confirms both sides landed together (or record the violation -- do not delete history).
_edge_symmetry_note: Every group below is stored as an UNORDERED set of unit ids. The checker does not care which unit's own SPEC card carries the prose 'Same commit as:' line -- SPEC/INDEX.md:302 documents that U011's card declares the U069 pairing while, at the time of the investigation, U069 was the only place the reciprocal reasoning lived out in full; U002<->U009 and U012<->U013 happen to be declared on both cards. Modeling the binding as a graph edge (not as two independent one-directional prose claims) means a future pair that is declared on only one side is still enforced in both directions, because the parser only needs to find the edge ONCE.
